findings.detail: Resolved inside this audit, before the verdict on these bytes. The PR shipped 'ریفریش نہیں ہو سکا۔'. That introduced a second rendering of the refresh action against 48 shipped values that use تازہ / تازہ کاری. This audit replaced the clause with 'تازہ کاری نہیں ہو سکی۔', which mirrors the shipped status 'تازہ کاری جاری ہے' (refresh in progress) and keeps feminine agreement. It is a one-term substitution drawn from shipped strings, not a new translation; the ledger binds the corrected bytes and the ur evidence record keeps the pre-correction finding and the commit that fixed it.
